chunks.text:
[Intro]
{instrumental only, music box and harp play the melody softly, no vocals}
positive_styles: music box, harp and soft strings
vocals soft and blended into the music, not upfront

chunks.text:
[Refrain]
The moon is in the sky,
the stars are winking slow.
Rest now, little one,
the night is soft and low.
positive_styles: music box, harp and soft strings
vocals soft and blended into the music, not upfront

chunks.text:
[Verse 1]
The trees have gone to sleep,
the lamps are glowing gold,
your blanket keeps you warm,
your hand is mine to hold.
positive_styles: music box, harp and soft strings
vocals soft and blended into the music, not upfront

chunks.text:
[Interlude]
{instrumental only, music box and harp play the refrain melody, no vocals}
positive_styles: music box, harp and soft strings
vocals soft and blended into the music, not upfront

chunks.text:
[Verse 2]
The wind is humming low,
the clouds are drifting by,
the moon will stay awake
and hum a lullaby.
positive_styles: music box, harp and soft strings
vocals soft and blended into the music, not upfront
